name: returns-policy-section
title: Returns policy section
description: Returns explained for humans: the window, how it works in four steps, what can and cannot be returned, and when the refund arrives.
docs: It works with no props: the copy it starts with is a real, shippable returns policy (30 days from delivery, four steps, what can and cannot be returned, refund times by payment method). Every line is a prop, so the legal wording can be swapped for each shop: windowDays fills the headline and the rule in words, facts are the terms beside the headline, steps (title, description, icon) are drawn as a numbered strip, eligible and excluded are one line each with a check or a cross, refundTimes are rows of the table (method, time, note), notice is a callout under it (a note unless you set its tone to tip or warning), startHref adds the Start a return button and contact a line with the way to reach someone. An empty facts, steps, eligible, excluded or refundTimes leaves that part out. headingAs is h2 by default; with h1 the titles of the parts are h2 and the steps h3. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link. It keeps no state, so it renders on the server. labels holds the fixed words.
